reports.standfirst: Nottingham Forest beat Manchester City 3-1 on the strength of two goals in 12 minutes early in the first half.
reports.account:
Forest went ahead after six minutes, Jair Cunha striking low into the corner with his left foot from inside the box. Twelve minutes after Cunha's goal they broke, and Xaver Schlager's pass sent Liam Delap through to finish high into the middle of the goal with his right foot, leaving City two goals down.
City pulled one back after 52 minutes through Rayan Cherki, who found the top corner with his left foot from inside the penalty area. Forest broke again 17 minutes from time, and Morgan Gibbs-White released Delap to finish into the top corner for his second.

sections.head: Delap's double
sections.pitch: Liam Delap now has three league goals this season, two of them from this match, and his three shots brought both.
sections.stake: Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza has him on the bench, for 10 points.

sections.head: Cunha's opener
sections.pitch: Jair Cunha shot three times in all, one of those efforts bringing the opening goal, which matched Delap's count of three shots for Forest.

sections.head: Schlager's assist
sections.pitch: Xaver Schlager took both of the defensive points on offer, the most any match pays, alongside the pass that sent Delap clear for the second goal.

keyStats.label: Points
keyStats.value: Delap 10 (Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza), Cunha 8, Schlager 7, Cherki 7 (Cowthenbeef)

reports.standfirst: Leeds United beat Tottenham Hotspur 1-0 through a late goal from the substitute Noah Okafor.
reports.account: Mathys Tel went off injured for Tottenham just before half-time. Dominic Calvert-Lewin turned a close-range shot from a corner wide early in the second half. After 79 minutes Noah Okafor, on as a substitute for Lukas Nmecha, put Leeds ahead with a low right-footed finish into the bottom corner.

sections.head: Justin's clean sheet
sections.pitch: James Justin completed the match without Leeds conceding, and he was paid one of the two defensive points that any match can offer.
sections.stake: Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza has him on the bench, for seven points.

sections.head: Trafford saves, Porro defends
sections.pitch: James Trafford made four saves and was beaten by nothing Tottenham sent his way, so Leeds kept their goal intact across the match. For the losing side, Pedro Porro earned one point for his defending, half of the most a single match pays.
sections.stake: The Raccoons has Porro on the bench, for six points; AtleticoTimHortons has Trafford, for eight points against The Raccoons.

keyStats.label: Points
keyStats.value: Trafford 8 (AtleticoTimHortons), Ampadu 7 (GlengarryHearts), Justin 7 (Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza), Elvedi 7

reports.standfirst: Arsenal beat Hull City 1-0, a second-half goal from Martin Ødegaard settling the match.
reports.account: John Egan headed a Regan Slater corner off target from close in after two minutes. Hull lost Semi Ajayi, forced off hurt after 69 minutes. Martin Ødegaard then won it for Arsenal after 72 minutes, a low right-footed shot from inside the six-yard box going into the corner.

sections.head: Ajayi off, Konsa unbreached
sections.pitch: Semi Ajayi and Ezri Konsa each came away with a defensive point, half the maximum on offer in a match. Konsa stayed on from the first whistle to the last for Arsenal, and the Gunners did not concede in all that time.
sections.stake: Bayern Bru has Ajayi on the bench, for seven points; its_ohi has Konsa, for seven points against Bayern Bru.

sections.head: Madueke creates, Magalhães unbeaten
sections.pitch: Noni Madueke shot four times and also set up four chances for teammates in the Arsenal attack. Gabriel Magalhães also saw the match through with Arsenal conceding nothing, another player alongside Konsa to go the distance without a goal against.
sections.stake: The Truffle Pigs claimed Madueke on Wednesday, for six points; Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza has Magalhães, for six points against The Truffle Pigs.

keyStats.label: Points
keyStats.value: Ødegaard 8 (Bayern Bru), Konsa 7 (its_ohi), Raya 7 (If anyone can, Bannan can), Ajayi 7 (Bayern Bru)

reports.standfirst: Fulham drew 1-1 with Newcastle United after coming from behind, the substitute Rodrigo Muniz cancelling out Jacob Murphy's strike.
reports.account:
Fulham lost Josh King, who went off injured after 72 minutes. Jacob Murphy put Newcastle ahead after 80 minutes with a low left-footed shot from outside the box. Three minutes after Murphy's goal Rodrigo Muniz, on for Gonzalo García, levelled from within six yards with his right foot, low into a corner.
Malick Thiaw came off hurt after 85 minutes. Deep into stoppage time Matias Fernandez-Pardo also had to go, with every change made.

sections.head: Murphy's goal
sections.pitch: Jacob Murphy added a defensive point to his goal, one of the two any single match can pay, so he contributed at both ends for Newcastle.

sections.head: King's injury
sections.pitch: Josh King was the first of three players to go off hurt in this match, and the only Fulham man among them, the other two being Newcastle's.
sections.stake: The Raccoons claimed him on Thursday, for three points.
